Hello Riverbend Health team,

We’ve identified the issue you’re seeing on the Spend dashboard (error E‑6105). Our engineering team is reviewing the root cause and will work to resolve the refresh problem as quickly as possible. I’ll keep you updated on our progress and let you know once the dashboard is back to normal.

Thank you for your patience.

Best regards,
Support Team
